newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - America West started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - America West started.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it initiated coverage on America West Holdings Corp with a buy rating.
-- said the company will shortly announce its strategy to enhance profitability at its major hubs in Phoenix, Arizona and Las Vegas.
-- said believes company has a "tremendous window of opportunity" to increase operating revenue at its Phoenis hib through capacity expansion and passenger mix improvements.
-- said America West is an undervalued, low-cost, full-service airline with outstanding earnings growth potential.
